text:
福建鄉試錄序
皇明文教漸被海外内百三十有
餘年士之佩道德誦詩書以
待用者日益以盛廼弘治十
四年巡按福建監察御史陸
偁以歳當大比集藩臬長貳
議所惟行乃言曰今天下山
===
東西河南北寔惟侯服其取
士
制額顧不得與江浙齒福建僻
在海濱去京師遠甚古惟荒
服之域顧得視諸浙額雖地
有廢興而抑以見我
皇明無外之仁今吾監臨祗順
punctuated:
福建鄉試錄序

皇明文教漸被海外内百三十有餘年，士之佩道德、誦詩書以待用者，日益以盛。廼弘治十四年，巡按福建監察御史陸偁，以歳當大比，集藩臬長貳，議所惟行，乃言曰：「今天下山東西、河南北，寔惟侯服，其取士制額，顧不得與江浙齒。福建僻在海濱，去京師遠甚，古惟荒服之域，顧得視諸浙額。雖地有廢興，而抑以見我皇明無外之仁。今吾監臨，祗順
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Fujian Provincial Examination

The civilizing influence of our august Ming dynasty’s literary learning has spread throughout the realm and beyond the seas for more than 130 years. Scholars who uphold the Way and virtue and recite the Odes and Documents while awaiting appointment have grown ever more numerous. In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi [1501], Lu Cheng 陸偁, Regional Inspector serving as Investigating Censor for Fujian, convened the chief and deputy officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions, since the year was one of the triennial examinations, to deliberate on the measures to be undertaken [?]. He then said: “Today, the regions east and west of the mountains and south and north of the Yellow River lie within what was indeed the domain of the feudal lords. Yet their imperially fixed quotas for selecting scholars cannot match those of Jiangsu and Zhejiang. Fujian lies remote on the seacoast, very far from the capital. In antiquity it belonged to the outermost wilderness domain, yet its quota is equal to Zhejiang’s. Although regions experience decline and prosperity, this also reveals the benevolence of our august Ming, which excludes no one. Now, as I supervise the examination, reverently following …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
德意惟二三同志是賴爰議聘儒
紳以司考校繼議新貢院飭
百需繼議屬吏之孰可充簾
外執事繼議戎衛官之孰可
臨事任使繼議事之孰可興
可革百凡有事一惟衆論是
詢時鎭守太監鄧原市舶太
===
監劉廣清戎監察御史莫立
之同心協德賛襄惟謹提學
副使劉丙先期歴試諸郡得
士二千人以俟監臨量地而
舍之僅容千七百有奇復通
試之取之如舍數于時廢者
興墜者舉才者用冗者汰應
punctuated: 德意，惟二三同志是賴。爰議聘儒紳以司考校，繼議新貢院、飭百需，繼議屬吏之孰可充簾外執事，繼議戎衛官之孰可臨事任使，繼議事之孰可興、可革。百凡有事，一惟衆論是詢。時鎭守太監鄧原、市舶太監劉廣、清戎監察御史莫立之，同心協德，賛襄惟謹。提學副使劉丙先期歴試諸郡，得士二千人以俟。監臨量地而舍之，僅容千七百有奇，復通試之，取之如舍數。于時廢者興，墜者舉，才者用，冗者汰。應
translation_en:
… the benevolent imperial intent, relying on our like-minded colleagues. We therefore discussed engaging Confucian gentlemen to oversee the examination and evaluation; next, renovating the examination compound and putting all necessary supplies in order; next, which subordinate officials could serve as staff outside the curtain; next, which military guard officials could be entrusted with duties as circumstances required; and next, which arrangements should be instituted or abolished. In every matter, we consulted the collective judgment alone.

At that time, Deng Yuan, the Grand Eunuch serving as Regional Defender; Liu Guang, the Grand Eunuch overseeing maritime trade; and Mo Lizhi, the Investigating Censor charged with inspecting military affairs, worked together with common purpose and gave conscientious assistance. Liu Bing, the Surveillance Vice Commissioner responsible for education, had previously conducted examinations throughout the prefectures and selected two thousand candidates to await the examination. The Supervising Official assessed the available space and arranged accommodations, but these could hold only a little over seventeen hundred. He therefore examined all the candidates again and selected a number matching the available accommodations. Thus, what had fallen into disuse was revived, what had lapsed was restored, the capable were employed, and the superfluous were removed. Those responding …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
聘儒紳同軌畢至八月壬子
鎖院右布政使夏祚右叅政
龐泮爲提調官副使魯昂丁
養浩爲監試官敎諭徐威姜
芳爲考試官學正王顔敎諭
李雍周廷徵方璽魏朝端羅
應文杜宅訓導俞瑞爲同考
===
試官與諸執事任使被簡而
充者肅然就事外則副使賈
錠左叅議徐貢右叅議王琳
僉事王寅劉愷彭誠夏易張
曇亦各一乃心力共濟厥美
事定入士三試之拔其尤者
九十人鋟文凡二十篇皆如
punctuated: 聘儒紳，同軌畢至。八月壬子，鎖院。右布政使夏祚、右叅政龐泮爲提調官，副使魯昂、丁養浩爲監試官，敎諭徐威、姜芳爲考試官，學正王顔、敎諭李雍、周廷徵、方璽、魏朝端、羅應文、杜宅、訓導俞瑞爲同考試官，與諸執事任使被簡而充者，肅然就事。外則副使賈錠、左叅議徐貢、右叅議王琳、僉事王寅、劉愷、彭誠、夏易、張曇，亦各一乃心力，共濟厥美。事定，入士三試之，拔其尤者九十人，鋟文凡二十篇，皆如
translation_en: …the invited scholars and gentlemen all arrived, united in purpose. On the renzi day of the eighth month, the examination compound was sealed. Xia Zuo, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Pang Pan, Right Administration Vice Commissioner, served as Proctors. Lu Ang and Ding Yanghao, Surveillance Vice Commissioners, served as Examination Monitoring Officials. Xu Wei and Jiang Fang, Confucian School Instructors, served as Examiners. Wang Yan, a Confucian School Instructor; Li Yong, Zhou Tingzheng, Fang Xi, Wei Chaoduan, Luo Yingwen, and Du Zhai, also Confucian School Instructors; and Yu Rui, an Assistant Confucian School Instructor, served as Associate Examiners. Together with the various functionaries and attendants selected to fill their posts, they solemnly took up their duties. Outside the compound, Surveillance Vice Commissioner Jia Ding, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner Xu Gong, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Wang Lin, and Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Wang Yin, Liu Kai, Peng Cheng, Xia Yi, and Zhang Tan likewise devoted their minds and energies to the task, jointly bringing this worthy undertaking to fruition. Once arrangements were settled, the candidates were admitted and examined in three sessions. Ninety of the most outstanding were selected, and twenty essays in all were engraved for printing, all conforming to…

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
式錄成将馳驛以
獻威當序諸首敢進一言為士
之登名者告焉福建濱海地
也秦漢以前無所考見入宋
而文物繁興遂齒于上國迨
我
皇明人文化成遠在海外重譯而
===
獻者皆識文字况處海內為
巨藩而被化之久者乎宜士
之詵詵焉出倍蓰於往昔也
昔人有謂海濱鄒魯今鄒魯
制額出福建下亦其驗矣諸士
子行將與天下士爭先挾其
所有以獻于
punctuated:
式。錄成，将馳驛以獻，威當序諸首，敢進一言，為士之登名者告焉。

福建濱海地也。秦漢以前，無所考見；入宋而文物繁興，遂齒于上國。迨我皇明，人文化成，遠在海外重譯而獻者，皆識文字，况處海內為巨藩而被化之久者乎？宜士之詵詵焉出，倍蓰於往昔也。昔人有謂海濱鄒魯，今鄒魯制額出福建下，亦其驗矣。諸士子行將與天下士爭先，挾其所有以獻于
translation_en:
…the prescribed form. With the record completed, it will be conveyed by the imperial post for presentation to the throne. I, Wei, am charged with placing a preface at its beginning, and venture to offer a word to those scholars whose names appear on the successful list.

Fujian is a coastal region. For the Qin and Han dynasties and earlier, nothing can be ascertained from the records. With the coming of the Song, its literary culture flourished, and it took its place alongside the cultivated heartland. Under our august Ming dynasty, the transforming influence of culture has reached such a degree that even those far overseas who come to present tribute through successive interpreters understand writing. How much more must this be true of a great province within the realm that has long received this civilizing influence? It is fitting that scholars should emerge in such abundance, several times more numerous than in the past. People of old called this region ‘Zou and Lu on the seacoast,’ likening it to the homelands of Mencius and Confucius. Now the prescribed examination quota for Zou and Lu falls below Fujian’s: this too bears out that description. You scholars will soon compete for precedence with scholars from all under Heaven, bringing your attainments to present at…

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
王庭躋華陟要有日矣自視昔
之涵濡於文教所以佩服誦
說者何如於今獨不知所以
仰
德意而圖報稱哉萬一舍其平素
而别為趨向則錄不足榮矣
威於是與有責焉盍相與戒
===
勉之
湖廣鄖陽府鄖西縣儒學教
諭徐威謹序
punctuated:
王庭，躋華陟要有日矣。自視昔之涵濡於文教，所以佩服誦說者何如？於今獨不知所以仰德意而圖報稱哉？萬一舍其平素而别為趨向，則錄不足榮矣。威於是與有責焉，盍相與戒勉之？
湖廣鄖陽府鄖西縣儒學教諭徐威謹序。
translation_en:
…at the royal court; the day will come when they rise to distinguished rank and important office. Let them reflect upon their former immersion in literary instruction: how did they cherish and uphold its teachings, recite and discuss them? Can they now fail to know how to revere the imperial benevolent intentions and seek to repay them fittingly? Should they abandon their accustomed principles and pursue a different course, this record would bring them no honor. I, Wei, would share responsibility for this. Should we not admonish and encourage one another?
Preface respectfully composed by Xu Wei, Instructor of the Confucian School of Yunxi County, Yunyang Prefecture, Huguang.

巡按福建監察御史陸偁〔君美浙江鄞縣人癸丑進士〕

===

直隸河間府滄州儒學學正王顔〔廷表應天府江寧縣人己酉貢士〕
湖廣長沙府益陽縣儒學教諭李雍〔象成江西新建縣人己酉貢士〕
江西吉安府安福縣儒學教諭周廷徵〔公賢湖廣麻城縣人己酉貢士〕
直隸池州府建德縣儒學教諭魏朝端〔邦直浙江餘姚縣人壬子貢士〕
山東東昌府臨清州館陶縣儒學教諭方璽〔天瑞通州衛人壬子貢士〕
punctuated:
弘治十四年福建鄉試

監臨官：
巡按福建監察御史陸偁〔君美，浙江鄞縣人，癸丑進士〕。

提調官：
福建等處承宣布政使司右布政使夏祚〔汝錫，直隸當塗縣人，戊戌進士〕。
福建等處承宣布政使司右參政龐泮〔原化，浙江天台縣人，甲辰進士〕。

福建等處提刑按察司副使曾昂〔光表，江西吉水縣人，丁未進士〕。
福建等處提刑按察司副使丁養浩〔師孟，浙江仁和縣人，丁未進士〕。

湖廣鄖陽府鄖西縣儒學教諭徐威〔廣威，江西泰和縣人，壬子貢士〕。
江西吉安府廬陵縣儒學教諭姜芳〔實夫，浙江蘭谿縣人，乙卯貢士〕。

同考試官：
直隸河間府滄州儒學學正王顔〔廷表，應天府江寧縣人，己酉貢士〕。
湖廣長沙府益陽縣儒學教諭李雍〔象成，江西新建縣人，己酉貢士〕。
江西吉安府安福縣儒學教諭周廷徵〔公賢，湖廣麻城縣人，己酉貢士〕。
直隸池州府建德縣儒學教諭魏朝端〔邦直，浙江餘姚縣人，壬子貢士〕。
山東東昌府臨清州館陶縣儒學教諭方璽〔天瑞，通州衛人，壬子貢士〕。
translation_en:
Fujian Provincial Examination, Fourteenth Year of Hongzhi (1501)

Supervising Official:
Lu Cheng, Investigating Censor assigned to patrol Fujian. His courtesy name was Junmei; he was from Yin County, Zhejiang, and was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the guichou year.

Proctors:
Xia Zuo, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of the Fujian Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Ruxi; he was from Dangtu County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate of the wuxu year.
Pang Pan, Right Administration Vice Commissioner of the Fujian Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Yuanhua; he was from Tiantai County, Zhejiang, and was a metropolitan graduate of the jiachen year.

Examination Supervisors:
Zeng Ang, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of the Fujian Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Guangbiao; he was from Jishui County, Jiangxi, and was a metropolitan graduate of the dingwei year.
Ding Yanghao, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of the Fujian Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Shimeng; he was from Renhe County, Zhejiang, and was a metropolitan graduate of the dingwei year.

Examiners:
Xu Wei, Instructor in the Confucian School of Yunxi County, Yunyang Prefecture, Huguang. His courtesy name was Guangwei; he was from Taihe County, Jiangxi, and was a tribute student (gongshi) of the renzi year.
Jiang Fang, Instructor in the Confucian School of Luling County, Ji’an Prefecture, Jiangxi. His courtesy name was Shifu; he was from Lanxi County, Zhejiang, and was a tribute student of the yimao year.

Associate Examiners:
Wang Yan, Instructor in the Confucian School of Cangzhou Subprefecture, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Tingbiao; he was from Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, and was a tribute student of the jiyou year.
Li Yong, Instructor in the Confucian School of Yiyang County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang. His courtesy name was Xiangcheng; he was from Xinjian County, Jiangxi, and was a tribute student of the jiyou year.
Zhou Tingzheng, Instructor in the Confucian School of Anfu County, Ji’an Prefecture, Jiangxi. His courtesy name was Gongxian; he was from Macheng County, Huguang, and was a tribute student of the jiyou year.
Wei Chaoduan, Instructor in the Confucian School of Jiande County, Chizhou Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Bangzhi; he was from Yuyao County, Zhejiang, and was a tribute student of the renzi year.
Fang Xi, Instructor in the Confucian School of Guantao County, Linqing Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong. His courtesy name was Tianrui; he was from Tongzhou Guard and was a tribute student of the renzi year.

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
直隸真定府藁城縣儒學教諭羅應文〔汝實浙江上虞縣人戊午貢士〕
直隸大名府內黃縣儒學教諭杜宅〔居仁陝西涇陽縣人壬子貢士〕
直隸徽州府祁門縣儒學訓導俞瑞〔廷信浙江鄞縣人丙午貢士〕
印卷官
福建等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷羅瑋〔宗器江西吉水縣人監生〕
福建等處提刑按察司經歷司經歷李昇〔騰霄廣西柳州衛人甲午貢士〕
收掌試卷官
漳州府知府彭桓〔景武江西吉水縣人庚戌進士〕
福州府同知周澤〔天雨浙江嘉善縣人庚戌進士〕
===
受卷官
邵武府同知陸勉〔懋之直隸江陰縣人癸卯貢士〕
汀州府推官程材〔良用直隸歙縣人丙辰進士〕
建寧府建陽縣知縣周杲〔啓明直隸華亭縣人癸丑進士〕

謄錄官
punctuated:
直隸真定府藁城縣儒學教諭羅應文〔汝實，浙江上虞縣人，戊午貢士〕。直隸大名府內黃縣儒學教諭杜宅〔居仁，陝西涇陽縣人，壬子貢士〕。直隸徽州府祁門縣儒學訓導俞瑞〔廷信，浙江鄞縣人，丙午貢士〕。

印卷官：
福建等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷羅瑋〔宗器，江西吉水縣人，監生〕。福建等處提刑按察司經歷司經歷李昇〔騰霄，廣西柳州衛人，甲午貢士〕。

邵武府同知陸勉〔懋之，直隸江陰縣人，癸卯貢士〕。汀州府推官程材〔良用，直隸歙縣人，丙辰進士〕。建寧府建陽縣知縣周杲〔啓明，直隸華亭縣人，癸丑進士〕。

彌封官：
漳州府長泰縣知縣李昕〔景初，廣東保昌縣人，甲午貢士〕。福州府永福縣知縣姚禎〔應隆，浙江歸安縣人，丁酉貢士〕。邵武府邵武縣知縣姜桂〔廷秀，江西安仁縣人，己未進士〕。

謄錄官：
translation_en:
Luo Yingwen, Instructor of the Confucian School of Gaocheng County, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Rushi. He was from Shangyu County, Zhejiang, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the wuwu year.
Du Zhai, Instructor of the Confucian School of Neihuang County, Daming Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Juren. He was from Jingyang County, Shaanxi, and was a tribute scholar of the renzi year.
Yu Rui, Assistant Instructor of the Confucian School of Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Tingxin. He was from Yin County, Zhejiang, and was a tribute scholar of the bingwu year.

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
君子學道則愛人
知斯三者則知所以脩身
人皆有所不忍達之於其所忍仁也人皆
有所不為達之於其所為義也人能
充無欲害人之心而仁不可勝用也
人能充無穿窬之心而義不可勝用
也
===
易經
敦復无悔中以自考也
柔在內而剛得中
日新之謂盛德
兼三才而兩之故易六畫而成卦分陰分
陽迭用柔剛故易六位而成章
書經
在璿璣玉衡以齊七政
若作和羹爾惟鹽梅
punctuated:
第壹場

四書
君子學道則愛人。
知斯三者，則知所以脩身。
人皆有所不忍，達之於其所忍，仁也；人皆有所不為，達之於其所為，義也。人能充無欲害人之心，而仁不可勝用也；人能充無穿窬之心，而義不可勝用也。

易經
敦復，无悔，中以自考也。
柔在內而剛得中。
日新之謂盛德。
兼三才而兩之，故易六畫而成卦；分陰分陽，迭用柔剛，故易六位而成章。

書經
在璿璣玉衡，以齊七政。
若作和羹，爾惟鹽梅。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books
When the gentleman studies the Way, he loves others.
Knowing these three, one knows how to cultivate oneself.
Everyone has things he cannot bear to do; extending this feeling to what he can bear to do is benevolence. Everyone has things he will not do; extending this restraint to what he does do is righteousness. If a person can fully extend the heart that has no desire to harm others, his benevolence will be inexhaustible in its application. If a person can fully extend the heart that refuses to break through walls or climb over them to steal, his righteousness will be inexhaustible in its application.

Book of Changes
Returning with steadfast sincerity brings no regret: through centrality, one examines oneself.
The yielding is within, and the firm occupies the central position.
Daily renewal is called abundant virtue.
Encompassing the Three Powers and doubling them, the Changes forms a hexagram with six lines. Distinguishing yin and yang and employing the yielding and the firm in alternation, the Changes forms a patterned whole through its six positions.

Book of Documents
He examined the jade-adorned celestial instrument and its jade sighting tube, to bring the seven celestial regulators into accord.
If I were making a well-seasoned soup, you would be its salt and sour plums.

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
六卿分職各率其屬以倡九牧阜成兆民
六年五服一朝又六年王乃時巡考
制度于四岳諸侯各朝于方岳大明
黜陟
用賚爾秬鬯一卣彤弓一彤矢百盧弓一
盧矢百
詩經
羔裘如濡洵直且侯彼其之子舍命不渝
羔裘豹飾孔武有力彼其之子邦之
===
司直羔裘晏兮三英粲兮彼其之子
邦之彦兮
豈敢定居一月三捷
卬盛于豆于豆于登其香始升上帝居歆
旣作泮宫淮夷攸服
春秋
州公如曹〔桓公五年〕公會宰周公齊侯宋子
衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯于葵丘〔僖公九年〕
公會齊侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯
punctuated:
六卿分職，各率其屬，以倡九牧，阜成兆民。

六年，五服一朝；又六年，王乃時巡，考制度于四岳，諸侯各朝于方岳，大明黜陟。

用賚爾秬鬯一卣，彤弓一，彤矢百，盧弓一，盧矢百。

詩經

羔裘如濡，洵直且侯。彼其之子，舍命不渝。羔裘豹飾，孔武有力。彼其之子，邦之司直。羔裘晏兮，三英粲兮。彼其之子，邦之彦兮。

豈敢定居？一月三捷。

卬盛于豆，于豆于登。其香始升，上帝居歆。

旣作泮宫，淮夷攸服。

春秋

州公如曹。〔桓公五年〕公會宰周公、齊侯、宋子、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯于葵丘。〔僖公九年〕

公會齊侯、宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯
translation_en:
The six ministers divide their duties, each leading his subordinates to guide the nine regional governors and bring prosperity and good order to the myriad people.

In the sixth year, those of the five service zones attend court once. After another six years, the king makes his tour of inspection, examining institutions and regulations at the four sacred mountains. The regional lords each attend his court at the sacred mountain of their region, and he clearly proclaims demotions and promotions.

I hereby bestow upon you one you-vessel of fragrant black-millet sacrificial wine, one red bow and a hundred red arrows, and one black bow and a hundred black arrows.

Book of Odes

His lambskin robe gleams as though moistened; truly upright and handsome is he. That gentleman holds to his charge without wavering. His lambskin robe is trimmed with leopard fur; very martial and strong is he. That gentleman upholds rectitude in the state. How fine his lambskin robe; how brilliant its three ornaments! That gentleman is an eminent man of the state.

How could we dare settle down to rest? In one month, three victories.

I fill the ritual dishes, both the dou-dishes and the deng-bowls. As their fragrance begins to rise, the Lord on High accepts the offering with pleasure.

Once the Pan Palace, the state school, had been built, the Huai Yi submitted.

Spring and Autumn Annals

The Duke of Zhou 州 went to Cao. 〔Fifth year of Duke Huan.〕 The duke met with the Grand Steward, the Duke of Zhou 周, the Marquis of Qi, the Viscount of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao at Kuiqiu. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xi.〕

The duke met with the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
于鹹〔僖公十三年〕諸侯城緣陵〔僖公十四年〕
公會宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯晉趙
盾癸酉同盟于新城〔文公十四年〕
晉趙穿帥師侵崇〔宣公元年〕秦師伐晉〔宣公二年〕
晉師白狄伐秦〔宣公八年〕
禮記
廟堂之上罍尊在阼犧尊在西廟堂之下
縣鼓在西應鼓在東
禮義立則貴賤等矣
===
===
是故君子不自大其事不自尚其功以求
處情過行弗率以求處厚彰人之善
而美人之功以求下賢
故孝弟忠順之行立而後可以為人
第貳塲
論
孔子與天地參而四時同
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢戒二千石脩職詔〔景帝後二年〕
punctuated:
于鹹〔僖公十三年〕。諸侯城緣陵〔僖公十四年〕。
公會宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯、晉趙盾，癸酉，同盟于新城〔文公十四年〕。
晉趙穿帥師侵崇〔宣公元年〕。秦師伐晉〔宣公二年〕。
晉師、白狄伐秦〔宣公八年〕。
禮記
廟堂之上，罍尊在阼，犧尊在西；廟堂之下，縣鼓在西，應鼓在東。
禮義立，則貴賤等矣。
是故君子不自大其事，不自尚其功，以求處情；過行弗率，以求處厚；彰人之善，而美人之功，以求下賢。
故孝弟忠順之行立，而後可以為人。
第貳塲
論
孔子與天地參，而四時同。
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢戒二千石脩職詔〔景帝後二年〕。
translation_en:
…at Xian. 〔Thirteenth year of Duke Xi.〕 The lords fortified Yuanling. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Xi.〕
The duke met with the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, the Earl of Cao, and Zhao Dun of Jin. On the guiyou day, they jointly concluded a covenant at Xincheng. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Wen.〕
Zhao Chuan of Jin led an army to invade Chong. 〔First year of Duke Xuan.〕 An army of Qin attacked Jin. 〔Second year of Duke Xuan.〕

Record of Rites
Above, in the ancestral temple hall, the lei wine vessels stand by the eastern steps, and the animal-shaped wine vessels stand to the west. Below the hall, the suspended drum stands to the west, and the answering drum stands to the east.
When ritual and righteousness are established, the noble and the humble have their proper ranks.
Thus the gentleman does not magnify his own deeds or exalt his own achievements, seeking thereby to remain true to his actual circumstances. He does not follow excessive conduct, seeking thereby to abide in substantial virtue. He makes others’ goodness manifest and praises their achievements, seeking thereby to place himself below the worthy.
Thus only after conduct marked by filial devotion, fraternal respect, loyalty, and obedience has been established can one fulfill the role of a human being.
Second Session
Discourse
Confucius forms a triad with Heaven and Earth and accords with the four seasons.
Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One topic from among these [?].〕
Compose, in the manner of the Han, an edict admonishing officials of the two-thousand-bushel rank to attend diligently to their duties. 〔Second year of Emperor Jing’s Later Era.〕

擬唐以宋璟為黃門侍郎誥〔神龍元年〕。
擬宋賜禮部進士呂蒙正等及第謝表〔太平興國元年〕。
判語〔五條〕：制書有違；别籍異財；男女婚姻；毆受業師；干名犯義。
第參塲
策五道
問：治天下者有本，不獨君身而已。朱子以為治急務告君，而必先之以輔翼太子、選任大臣。蓋太子所以嗣天下，大臣所以輔天下，根本之地，所繫尤大，不可以不謹也。我朝宣宗章皇帝嘗以君臣為人倫之首，故所製五
translation_en:
Draft a Tang proclamation appointing Song Jing as Vice Director of the Chancellery. 〔First year of Shenlong〕
Draft a Song memorial of thanks for the granting of examination degrees to Lü Mengzheng and the other metropolitan graduates examined by the Ministry of Rites. 〔First year of Taiping Xingguo〕
Legal judgments 〔five items〕: Contravening an imperial decree; establishing a separate household registration and dividing family property; marriage between men and women; striking one’s teacher; bringing accusations against senior relatives in violation of familial duty.
Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: Governing All under Heaven has its foundations, which extend beyond the ruler’s own person. When Master Zhu advised his ruler on the urgent tasks of government, he invariably placed first the guidance and support of the crown prince and the selection and appointment of high ministers. For the crown prince is to inherit All under Heaven, and high ministers are to assist in its governance. These foundational positions carry particularly great consequences and must be treated with care. Emperor Xuanzong Zhang of our dynasty once regarded the relationship between ruler and minister as foremost among human relationships. Thus, in the book he composed, the Five…

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
倫書於建儲任人之事特加詳焉有謂
狀大多知者有謂聖表有異者有欲其
動皆由禮者有欲其練歷庶務者皆所
以為太子計也至述
太祖高皇帝之訓累數十言而不足不知於所
謂輔翼者何切有謂首百司而理陰陽
者有謂理天下必資良佐者有謂每藉
輔佐以成其理者有謂公為元老宜輔
朕政者皆所以為大臣責也至述
===
太祖高皇帝之訓歷十數事而可指不知於所
謂選任者何最今我
皇上嗣守大業動由
舊章
東宮聰明仁孝行已端矣而薰陶德性愈重
其託大臣忠敬直亮職已脩矣而咨諏
委任益盡其道其所以培植天下之根
本如此其固抑皆有得
祖宗貽謀之深意乎書曰聖有謨訓明徵定保
punctuated: 倫書，於建儲任人之事特加詳焉。有謂「狀大多知」者，有謂「聖表有異」者，有欲其動皆由禮者，有欲其練歷庶務者，皆所以為太子計也。至述太祖高皇帝之訓，累數十言而不足，不知於所謂輔翼者何切？有謂「首百司而理陰陽」者，有謂「理天下必資良佐」者，有謂「每藉輔佐以成其理」者，有謂「公為元老，宜輔朕政」者，皆所以為大臣責也。至述太祖高皇帝之訓，歷十數事而可指，不知於所謂選任者何最？今我皇上嗣守大業，動由舊章。東宮聰明仁孝，行已端矣，而薰陶德性愈重其託；大臣忠敬直亮，職已脩矣，而咨諏委任益盡其道。其所以培植天下之根本如此其固，抑皆有得祖宗貽謀之深意乎？《書》曰：「聖有謨訓，明徵定保。」
translation_en:
…in the Book of the Five Human Relationships, particular detail is devoted to establishing the heir apparent and appointing officials. Some passages speak of his being “fully grown and knowledgeable” [?]; others say that “his sagely bearing is extraordinary.” Some wish his every action to accord with ritual propriety; others wish him to gain practical experience in the many affairs of government. All these make provision for the crown prince. When the instructions of Emperor Gao, Taizu, are recounted, even several dozen statements do not suffice. Which of these, we ask, is most pertinent to what is meant by assisting and guiding the crown prince?

Some passages speak of “presiding over the hundred offices and harmonizing yin and yang”; others say that “governing the realm necessarily depends upon worthy assistants,” that “one always relies upon assistants to accomplish its governance,” or that “you, as a senior statesman, should assist in my government.” All these set out the responsibilities of the high ministers. When the instructions of Emperor Gao, Taizu, are recounted, more than a dozen matters can be individually identified. Which of these, we ask, is foremost in what is meant by selecting and appointing ministers?

Now our emperor has inherited and maintains the great imperial enterprise, following established precedents in every action. The crown prince is intelligent, humane, and filial, and his conduct is already upright; yet still greater importance is placed upon the charge of cultivating his virtue and character. The high ministers are loyal, reverent, upright, and trustworthy, and already discharge their duties well; yet the proper methods of consulting them and entrusting them with responsibilities are followed ever more fully. Thus does he cultivate the foundations of the realm and make them firm. Is this all because he has grasped the profound intent of the plans bequeathed by his imperial ancestors? The Book of Documents says: “The sage has counsels and instructions; clearly verify them, establish them, and preserve them.” …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
諸生皆囿於
盛治之下盍宣揚
聖訓之萬一以示天下後世
問六經之文尚矣自周而下文之純駁不
齊由人之學術有淺深世道有隆汚耳
請相與評之文者貫道之器唐人有是
言矣何以有以本為末之譏文必與道
俱宋人有是言矣何以有二本之說法
言擬乎論語者也何以譏其為長楊較
===
獵之流聖德頌無愧風雅者也何以譏
其為李斯頌秦之陋大學之明明德學
也有言為文之大者何歟聖門之道義
德也有指為文之一般者何歟有治世
之文有衰世之文有亂世之文何以見
有譎諫之文有裁成之文有通儒之文
何以名後世諸子之文不一也何者為
文之祖聖人經世之文常道也何者為
經之變作文必要悟入有讀伯夷傳而
punctuated:
諸生皆囿於盛治之下，盍宣揚聖訓之萬一，以示天下後世？

問：六經之文尚矣！自周而下，文之純駁不齊，由人之學術有淺深、世道有隆汚耳。請相與評之。文者，貫道之器，唐人有是言矣，何以有以本為末之譏？文必與道俱，宋人有是言矣，何以有二本之說？《法言》擬乎《論語》者也，何以譏其為《長楊》《較獵》之流？《聖德頌》無愧《風》《雅》者也，何以譏其為李斯頌秦之陋？《大學》之明明德，學也，有言為文之大者，何歟？聖門之道義，德也，有指為文之一般者，何歟？有治世之文，有衰世之文，有亂世之文，何以見？有譎諫之文，有裁成之文，有通儒之文，何以名？後世諸子之文不一也，何者為文之祖？聖人經世之文，常道也，何者為經之變？作文必要悟入，有讀《伯夷傳》而
translation_en:
You students all live within the embrace of this flourishing rule. Why not proclaim even a small portion of the imperial teachings, to make them known to all under Heaven and to later generations?

Question: The writings of the Six Classics are venerable indeed! From the Zhou onward, writings have differed in their purity or admixture simply because people’s learning has varied in depth, and the condition of the age has risen or declined. Let us assess these matters together. A Tang writer said, “Writing is a vessel that carries the Way.” Why, then, was this criticized as treating the root as a branch? A Song writer said, “Writing must accompany the Way.” Why, then, was there talk of “two roots”? Model Sayings (Fayan) takes the Analects as its model. Why was it criticized as belonging to the same class as Tall Poplars (Changyang) and The Hunt (Jiaolie [?])? The Eulogy on Sagely Virtue (Shengde song) is worthy of comparison with the Airs and Odes. Why was it criticized as sharing the baseness of Li Si’s praise of Qin? “Making luminous virtue shine forth” in the Great Learning concerns learning. Why did someone call it the greatest form of writing? The Way and righteousness taught in the school of the Sage concern virtue. Why did someone identify them as one aspect of writing? There is writing characteristic of an age of good government, of an age of decline, and of an age of disorder. How can these distinctions be discerned? There is writing of indirect remonstrance, writing that shapes and perfects, and writing of comprehensively learned scholars. On what grounds are these named? The writings of the various masters of later ages differ: which constitutes the progenitor of writing? The writings through which the sages ordered the world embody the constant Way: which constitutes a variation within the classics? Composing writing necessarily requires an intuitive breakthrough in understanding. There were those who read the Biography of Bo Yi and …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
悟者有讀貨殖傳而悟者誰歟學文必
得古法有自戰國策而得者有自孟子
書而得者誰歟文有六說三等之辨古
能一之何道文有四科三易之殊今欲
備之何由唐之文莫過於韓柳其學之
有得於六經者何在宋之文莫過於歐
蘇其文之有同於韓柳者何居經所以
明道後世明道之儒其文章有可以表
裏六經者乎學貴乎窮經後世窮經之
===
士其文章有可為六經之階梯者乎夫
由六經之階梯而造乎六經之蘊奧則
漢唐以下辭章之文不足貴矣請條陳
之毋忽
問古之人布衣而有公輔之望江湖而有
廟堂之思則宰相之職雖在筮仕之初
要不可以不講也三代而上若伏羲之
六佐黃帝之六相唐虞之百揆有商之
伊傅成周之周召固無容議矣三代
punctuated:
悟者，有讀《貨殖傳》而悟者，誰歟？學文必得古法，有自《戰國策》而得者，有自《孟子》書而得者，誰歟？文有六說三等之辨，古能一之何道？文有四科三易之殊，今欲備之何由？唐之文莫過於韓柳，其學之有得於六經者何在？宋之文莫過於歐蘇，其文之有同於韓柳者何居？經所以明道，後世明道之儒，其文章有可以表裏六經者乎？學貴乎窮經，後世窮經之士，其文章有可為六經之階梯者乎？夫由六經之階梯而造乎六經之蘊奧，則漢唐以下辭章之文不足貴矣。請條陳之，毋忽。

問：古之人，布衣而有公輔之望，江湖而有廟堂之思，則宰相之職，雖在筮仕之初，要不可以不講也。三代而上，若伏羲之六佐、黃帝之六相、唐虞之百揆、有商之伊傅、成周之周召，固無容議矣。三代
translation_en:
…attained understanding; others attained understanding by reading the Biographies of the Money-makers. Who were they? In studying composition, one must master ancient methods. Some acquired them from the Strategies of the Warring States, others from the book of Mencius. Who were they? In writing there are distinctions of six theories and three grades [?]: by what method could the ancients unify them? Writing also differs in its four categories and three kinds of ease [?]: how may one now encompass them all? Among Tang writers, none surpassed Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan. Where did their learning draw upon the Six Classics? Among Song writers, none surpassed Ouyang Xiu and Su Shi. In what respects did their writing resemble that of Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan? The Classics serve to illuminate the Way. Among later Confucian scholars who illuminated the Way, were there any whose writings could complement the Six Classics, inwardly and outwardly? Learning values a thorough understanding of the Classics. Among later scholars who studied the Classics exhaustively, were there any whose writings could serve as steps toward the Six Classics? If, by ascending such steps, one reaches the profound mysteries of the Six Classics, then the literary compositions of the Han and Tang and subsequent ages are hardly worthy of esteem. Please set out your answers point by point; do not treat this lightly.

Question: Among the ancients, some, though still commoners, were regarded as having the promise of chief ministers; others, though living far from office, gave thought to affairs of the court. Thus, even at the beginning of an official career, one must study the duties of a chief councilor. From the Three Dynasties back to earlier times, such figures as Fuxi’s six assistants, the Yellow Emperor’s six ministers, the directors of the hundred offices under Tang Yao and Yu Shun, Yi Yin and Fu Yue of Shang, and the Dukes of Zhou and Shao of Zhou certainly leave no room for debate. The Three Dynasties…

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
下稱漢相者必曰蕭曹丙魏稱唐相者
必曰房杜姚宋稱宋相者必曰韓范富
歐皆足以為賢矣然數子之外豈無可
稱之人歟夫論其世必知其名循其人
必責其實就一人而論之何者為長何
者為短歟就一代而論之何人為優何
人為劣歟就數子而通論之又何人為
卓冠歟諸士子行將陟華躋要以效用
于時不知所設施者以何人為法以何
===
事為先以何言為要歟夫比方人物固
聖人不暇為不知人亦君子所當患幸
悉陳之
問將者三軍之司命國家安危之所繫也
求之貴乎廣任之貴乎專求之不廣則
才或遺任之不專則才難盡試以昔人
之所論者言之有謂就諸班中搜羅智
勇者有謂只於軍中自可求將者有謂
可復武舉而為之新制者有謂請近臣
punctuated:
下，稱漢相者必曰蕭、曹、丙、魏，稱唐相者必曰房、杜、姚、宋，稱宋相者必曰韓、范、富、歐，皆足以為賢矣。然數子之外，豈無可稱之人歟？夫論其世，必知其名；循其人，必責其實。就一人而論之，何者為長，何者為短歟？就一代而論之，何人為優，何人為劣歟？就數子而通論之，又何人為卓冠歟？諸士子行將陟華躋要，以效用于時，不知所設施者，以何人為法，以何事為先，以何言為要歟？夫比方人物，固聖人不暇為；不知人，亦君子所當患。幸悉陳之。

問：將者，三軍之司命，國家安危之所繫也。求之貴乎廣，任之貴乎專。求之不廣，則才或遺；任之不專，則才難盡。試以昔人之所論者言之：有謂就諸班中搜羅智勇者，有謂只於軍中自可求將者，有謂可復武舉而為之新制者，有謂請近臣
translation_en:
…after the Three Dynasties, those who speak of Han chief ministers invariably name Xiao He, Cao Shen, Bing Ji, and Wei Xiang; those who speak of Tang chief ministers invariably name Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui, Yao Chong, and Song Jing; and those who speak of Song chief ministers invariably name Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, Fu Bi, and Ouyang Xiu. All deserve to be considered worthy. Yet beyond these men, were there no others deserving praise? In discussing their age, one must know their reputations; in examining the men themselves, one must demand evidence of their actual accomplishments. Considering each man individually, what were his strengths and what were his shortcomings? Considering each dynasty, who was superior and who inferior? Considering all these men together, who stood preeminent? You candidates will soon ascend to illustrious and important posts and put your abilities to use in your time. In carrying out your duties, whom will you take as your model, what affairs will you put first, and what words will you regard as essential? Comparing and ranking people was admittedly something the Sage had no leisure to undertake; yet failure to understand people is also something a gentleman should be concerned about. Please set forth your views in full.

Question: A general holds the lives of the armies in his charge; the security or peril of the state depends upon him. In seeking generals, breadth is essential; in entrusting them with command, undivided authority is essential. If the search is not broad, talent may be overlooked; if authority is not undivided, talent can hardly be fully employed. Consider what men of earlier times have said on this subject. Some proposed searching among the various ranks for men of intelligence and courage; some held that generals could be found within the army itself; some proposed restoring the military examinations and devising new regulations for them; and some proposed asking the ministers close to the throne…

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
及藩鎭大臣各舉有武略者其求將之
方可謂廣矣然止於此而已乎抑别有
他道乎有言端拱於委任者有言宜久
於其職者有言進退不可輕用人言者
有言功必賞罪必刑者其任將之道可
謂專矣然止於是而已乎抑或有他術
乎方今醜虜桀驁邊境告急兵不可一
日而去戰不可一日而忘則將誠不可
不廣求而專任之也諸士子懷有用之
===
學必慮之熟矣請悉陳之將采擇以
獻
問先民有言達時務者為俊傑知大體者
為志士諸士子游庠序之中抱用世之
學皆有志之士俊傑之才也特舉其一
二時務大體以商確之科目賢才所由
出也古今之法詳矣何者為至當考課
治道所由興也古今之法備矣何者為
至要教化以士習為先何法而可以去
punctuated:
及藩鎭大臣各舉有武略者，其求將之方可謂廣矣。然止於此而已乎？抑别有他道乎？有言端拱於委任者，有言宜久於其職者，有言進退不可輕用人言者，有言功必賞、罪必刑者，其任將之道可謂專矣。然止於是而已乎？抑或有他術乎？方今醜虜桀驁，邊境告急，兵不可一日而去，戰不可一日而忘，則將誠不可不廣求而專任之也。諸士子懷有用之學，必慮之熟矣。請悉陳之，將采擇以獻。
問：先民有言：「達時務者為俊傑，知大體者為志士。」諸士子游庠序之中，抱用世之學，皆有志之士、俊傑之才也。特舉其一二時務大體以商確之。科目，賢才所由出也，古今之法詳矣，何者為至當？考課，治道所由興也，古今之法備矣，何者為至要？教化以士習為先，何法而可以去
translation_en:
…and the great ministers commanding regional garrisons each recommend men versed in military strategy. These methods of seeking generals may be called broad indeed. But should one stop here? Or are there other ways? Some have said that the ruler should fold his hands and entrust responsibilities to others; some, that generals should remain long in their posts; some, that in promoting or dismissing them one must not lightly act upon what others say; and some, that merit must be rewarded and offenses punished. These principles for employing generals may be said to give them undivided responsibility. But should one stop here? Or are there other methods? At present, the vile northern foes are unruly, and the frontier reports emergencies. Troops cannot be dispensed with for even a day, nor can warfare be forgotten for even a day. Generals must therefore indeed be sought widely and entrusted with undivided responsibility. You candidates possess learning suited to practical use and must have considered these matters thoroughly. Please set forth your views in full; selections will be made for presentation to the throne.
Question: Our forebears said: “Those who understand the affairs of their time are outstanding talents; those who grasp the larger principles are men of resolve.” You candidates study in the schools and possess learning suited to service in the world. You are all men of resolve and outstanding ability. We therefore raise a few matters concerning current affairs and larger principles for careful discussion. The examination system is the means by which worthy talent comes forth. Its methods, ancient and modern, have been elaborated in detail: which are most fitting? Performance evaluations are the means by which good government flourishes. Their methods, ancient and modern, are fully developed: which are most essential? In moral instruction and transformation, priority belongs to the habits of scholars. By what method can one eliminate …

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
其奔競之風致治以得民為本何施而
可以結其愛戴之心甲兵所以禦侮今
戎伍耗矣若何而可以足兵穀粟所以
養民今倉廩竭矣若何而可以足食夷
狄不能無也伊欲使之不擾吾邊也何
道異端不能免也伊欲使之不惑吾民
也何方凡是數者其所關於時務甚大
於此而不知惡乎有所知耶其為我詳
著于篇
punctuated: 其奔競之風？致治以得民為本，何施而可以結其愛戴之心？甲兵所以禦侮，今戎伍耗矣，若何而可以足兵？穀粟所以養民，今倉廩竭矣，若何而可以足食？夷狄不能無也，伊欲使之不擾吾邊也，何道？異端不能免也，伊欲使之不惑吾民也，何方？凡是數者，其所關於時務甚大，於此而不知，惡乎有所知耶？其為我詳著于篇。
translation_en: …their propensity to scramble for advancement? Achieving good government rests on winning over the people: what measures can secure their affection and allegiance? Arms and troops serve to repel aggression, yet the ranks are now depleted: how can sufficient troops be secured? Grain sustains the people, yet the granaries are now exhausted: how can sufficient food be secured? Foreign peoples cannot be made to cease to exist; if we wish to keep them from disturbing our borders, what course should we follow? Heterodox teachings cannot be avoided; if we wish to keep them from deluding our people, what method should we employ? All these matters have a very great bearing on the affairs of the day. If one knows nothing of these, what can one claim to know? Set forth your answers for me in detail in your essays.

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
中式舉人九十名
第一名張燮閩縣儒士易
第二名陳艮山莆田縣學生詩
第三名戴大賓莆田縣儒士書
第四名張天顯閩縣學生春秋
第五名鄭伯和福州府學生禮記
第六名王忠泉州府學增廣生易
第七名黃鞏莆田縣儒士詩
===
第八名黃肯堂興化府學增廣生書
第九名林輅晉江縣儒士易
第十名林容漳浦縣學增廣生詩

title: 弘治十四年福建鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
君子學道則愛人
張燮
同考試官訓導俞批題以禮樂立說前
後貫串渾然無斧鑿痕作手也
同考試官教諭魏批文足以發題意他
日有位必能推所學以愛人者
考試官教諭姜批親切有味
===
考試官教諭徐批文有曲折斡旋可
美
惟在上知所學則於下知所愛夫愛人本於學
道也然則君子之於道可不知所學哉昔子游
以禮樂治武城因夫子莞爾之戲而質以平日
所聞之言如此意謂君子任民社之寄有家國
之責固不可以不學學不可以不致於道必也
格物致知而於事物之理無不明篤志力行而
於事物之理無不體如道不外乎禮也而禮有
punctuated:
第壹場
四書
